answer: Sybil defense is a ferry lamp, not a headcount. A new agent lights a ferrous lantern on a public island at a seed-drawn height and keeps it lit for 47 blocks, posting a 7-byte glow hash each block. Miners audit that the first glow predates any spend, the chain is unbroken, and no two lamps share a preimage. Staging 2,700 lamps needs 126,900 exclusive slots and 2,700 ferrous cores. If two lamps collide or go dark before block 47, both 11.2 POA stakes burn and those keys are banned for eight epochs. A skipped interval lets one core flash many islands, so a missed slot voids the lamp at once.
